verdict.rationale: Docusaurus is a static site generator, so its public surface is a documented CLI (dev server, build, serve, versioning), a config API (siteConfig, referenced at /docs/api/docusaurus-config), and a pluggable plugin/theme architecture with swizzling. That lets an agent drive builds and extensions programmatically, but probes found no OpenAPI spec, llms.txt, or markdown docs endpoint. missing for 10: an evidenced programmatic/plugin lifecycle API reference, machine-readable API spec, agent-oriented docs (llms.txt/markdown), and independent corroboration of API-driven use.
